mentions.name: Belgie
mentions.description: A Python project that makes it easy to build MCP UIs, for adding a UI to a Model Context Protocol server.
mentions.source_excerpt: And the server happens to be in python, you should check out: https://mplemay.github.io/belgie/examples/mcp/. It is a project I have been working on which makes it easy to build MCP UIs from python.
mentions.author: mplemay
